title: Multiple Choice - Conversation Completion
description: Choose the correct response to complete the conversation.

questions.text:
Mark: 'Your presentation on traditional Andean weaving techniques was truly fascinating!'
Elena: '______________________________'
options: Thank you, I spent months doing research to make sure the details were accurate.
No problem, we can reschedule our presentation for next Friday morning instead.
I am afraid that the university library is already closed for weekend cleaning.
You must submit the printed assignment to the teacher before three this afternoon.
questions.correct_answer: Thank you, I spent months doing research to make sure the details were accurate.

questions.text:
Sophie: 'I feel slightly nervous about experiencing culture shock during my exchange semester in Tokyo.'
Ken: '______________________________'
options: Joining an international student club will help you adapt much faster to daily life.
The subway system in that city is regarded as one of the most punctual in the world.
We have already submitted the final project proposal to the academic scholarship committee.
You should buy several extra suitcases before booking your round-trip flight tickets.
questions.correct_answer: Joining an international student club will help you adapt much faster to daily life.

questions.text:
Tom: 'How do you handle the language barrier when shopping in crowded local morning markets?'
An: '______________________________'
options: The flight was delayed for three hours due to heavy thunderstorms over the coastline.
We plan to order two large bowls of beef noodle soup for our lunch at the restaurant.
I usually rely on a pocket translation app and polite hand gestures to negotiate prices.
My younger brother prefers watching foreign action movies without any subtitles on.
questions.correct_answer: I usually rely on a pocket translation app and polite hand gestures to negotiate prices.

questions.text:
Clara: 'Would you like to come with us to the international carnival parade this Saturday?'
David: '______________________________'
options: My train departs from platform four in approximately fifteen minutes from now.
We have to clean our dormitory rooms before the weekly inspection on Monday morning.
The museum ticket counter does not accept cash payments on public holiday weekends.
I would love to join, especially if we get to see the spectacular marching bands.
questions.correct_answer: I would love to join, especially if we get to see the spectacular marching bands.

questions.text:
Liam: 'Do you know where we can sample authentic regional street food around here?'
Hoa: '______________________________'
options: You must leave your umbrella in the metallic stand near the main entrance lobby.
The local post office operates from eight in the morning until four in the afternoon.
That vibrant food stall down the alley serves fantastic homemade steamed dumplings.
We should finish reading the historical biography before attending the lecture.
questions.correct_answer: That vibrant food stall down the alley serves fantastic homemade steamed dumplings.

questions.text:
Lucas: 'Why are those neighborhood children carrying colorful pumpkin buckets tonight?'
Emma: '______________________________'
options: Her parents decided to renovate the old garage into a cozy wooden workshop space.
They are collecting chocolate and fruit candy while playing trick or treat tonight.
The electrical technician repaired all the broken ceiling lights inside the studio.
We need to return these borrowed reference encyclopedias to the municipal archive.
questions.correct_answer: They are collecting chocolate and fruit candy while playing trick or treat tonight.

questions.text:
Minh: 'Would you like to try bamboo dancing with our folk performance group after class?'
Sarah: '______________________________'
options: Our flight reservation includes two complimentary meals and one piece of baggage.
You should wash those fresh vegetables thoroughly before preparing the garden salad.
The final examination scores were posted on the student bulletin board yesterday.
That sounds like fun, although I will need someone to show me the basic rhythms first.
questions.correct_answer: That sounds like fun, although I will need someone to show me the basic rhythms first.

questions.text:
Daniel: 'Where did you get that beautifully painted ceramic bowl on your bookshelf?'
Linh: '______________________________'
options: The conference speaker discussed modern renewable energy technologies for an hour.
I bought it as a souvenir from an artisan workshop in the southern craft village.
We will probably need another gallon of paint to finish coating the living room.
Her bicycle chain snapped while she was pedaling up the steep suburban incline.
questions.correct_answer: I bought it as a souvenir from an artisan workshop in the southern craft village.

questions.text:
Jessica: 'What did you find most meaningful about your youth cultural exchange trip?'
Bao: '______________________________'
options: We purchased five kilograms of organic oranges from the cooperative farm outlet.
My laptop battery lasted throughout the entire four-hour online business seminar.
The chemical laboratory was closed early for routine ventilation disinfection work.
I learned to appreciate diverse cultural traditions and formed lasting friendships.
questions.correct_answer: I learned to appreciate diverse cultural traditions and formed lasting friendships.

questions.text:
Peter: 'Is the growing popularity of foreign holiday celebrations a cause for alarm?'
Mai: '______________________________'
options: You can borrow up to three audiobooks at the same time using your campus library card.
Our university athletic team won two gold medals at the regional championship.
Not really, because young people can celebrate global events while valuing their roots.
The municipal water supply company announced a planned maintenance outage tomorrow.
questions.correct_answer: Not really, because young people can celebrate global events while valuing their roots.
